title: Implement the wtp update command
description: Add wtp update to query the repository latest release, compare semantic versions, select the executable for the current OS and architecture, verify its published checksum, preserve executable permissions, and safely replace the currently installed binary whether it is project-local, user-local, or global. Report permission and Windows replacement constraints clearly and test no-op, upgrade, checksum-failure, and unsupported-platform paths.

comments.author: Codex
comments.message: Implemented wtp update using the shared release contract: strict SemVer precedence, exact GOOS/GOARCH selection, HTTPS GitHub release discovery, streamed SHA-256 verification, permission-preserving symlink-aware replacement, atomic Unix publication, and deferred rollback-aware Windows self-replacement with clear permission/error paths. Added network-isolated deterministic coverage for no-op, upgrade, checksum failure, unsupported platform, API/tag/asset failures, stage cleanup, symlink behavior, and replacement rollback/safety; updated help, README, release docs, and changelog. Verification passed: go test -race ./..., go vet ./..., ./scripts/check.sh, pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/check.ps1, development-build CLI smoke, git diff --check, and executable plus updater-test compilation for darwin/linux/windows on amd64/arm64. No tests contacted real GitHub; no commit, push, tag, publish, or PR was performed.
